subject: Update on your Classic Bulldog Tee
body:
Hi Tauhid,

The Classic Bulldog Tee in size S is currently out of stock. We expect a restock from our print partner, but it depends on invoice approval and payment before they can ship, so we can’t confirm an arrival date yet.

We’ll follow up when we have an update on the restock timing. Thanks for your patience.

Campus Customs

subject: September rent payment pending approval
body:
Dear Elm City Properties,

Our records show that the $2,400.00 rent for the Chapel Street shop is due September 2, 2026. The payment is pending internal human approval and has not yet been paid. We will follow up once approval is complete.

Regards,
Chapel Street shop

subject: Navy hoodies: 8 available now, 12 pending
body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We can offer 8 navy hoodies in size M from current stock, with the remaining 12 pending funding and a purchase order. The approved 15% discount brings the price to $49.30 each; our gross margin is $27.30 per hoodie (55.4%) against a $22.00 cost.

You can take the 8 available now and wait for the other 12, or let us know if you’d prefer to wait for all 20. No restock date is confirmed: the remaining units depend on funding and an order being placed. If that happens, the vendor’s lead time is 5 days from shipment/order timing, and we’ll confirm an estimate once the order is approved and placed.

Campus Customs
